flags.title: All three estimates are user-provided and could not be independently verified
flags.detail: E-01 ($614), E-02 ($550) and E-03 ($135) are quotations supplied by the project owner from outreach dated 2026-08-30. No official source exists for a vendor's verbal/written quote; per the verification rule they are published as user-provided with verification=false, and nothing was inferred or adjusted. The provider names were matched to licensed entities by name + San Francisco address + classification, but the project owner must confirm these are the same businesses contacted.

flags.title: The three quotes describe different scopes and are not directly comparable
flags.detail: E-03 ($135) is 'repair or adjust plunger handle'; E-02 ($550) is 'replace lever for the bathtub plug and spout with diverter, labor and materials'; E-01 ($614) is 'replacing waste and overflow' (full assembly). None of the three quotes explicitly includes drywall opening or ceiling restoration, which the fallback approach (working from below through a storage-unit ceiling) will likely require (R-06, R-07). Third-party guides put drywall patching at $300–$930 on top of plumbing work.

flags.title: CSLB statuses are point-in-time (data as of 2026-11-06)
flags.detail: License status was verified against official CSLB license-detail pages on 2026-11-06. CSLB states status 'can change at any time' and that its database may lag. Re-check each linked CSLB page before contracting. Worker's-comp notes: Bay Area Plumbing (#757796) and SF Building Group (#1106131) are WC-exempt (certified no employees); Fast Response's WC policy (#1024971) shows an expiration of 2026-12-18.

flags.title: No provider in the set holds a C-9 Drywall classification
flags.detail: None of the verified licenses includes C-9 (Drywall). The all-in-one requirement (R-07) is therefore satisfiable in two CSLB-sanctioned ways: (a) hire a B-licensed general contractor who contracts both the C-36 plumbing and a licensed C-9 drywall subcontractor under one contract (Ace #829071 and We Do Construction #1096552 hold B + C-36; SF Building Group #1106131 holds B), or (b) hire a C-36 plumber and separately contract a licensed drywall contractor. CSLB's official guidance: a B contractor is appropriate when a job requires more than two types of work and cannot legally contract for a single trade only.

source_links.label: CSLB — Find A Licensed Contractor (B vs C multi-trade guidance)

flags.title: Access-panel code section numbering differs across CPC editions
flags.detail: The 12-inch access requirement for concealed slip-joint connections (directly relevant to tub waste/overflow serviceability) is numbered 402.10 in the 2022 California Plumbing Code / UPC, but 404.2 in the 2010 CPC. Links to both editions are provided; the requirement text itself is consistent.

flags.title: Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter: CSLB address differs from website address
flags.detail: CSLB record of record for license #1024971 lists 236 W Portal Ave #459, San Francisco 94127; the company website displays 4444 Geary Blvd Ste 203, San Francisco 94118. Same license number and phone on both. Likely a mailing/office address difference; confirm at contract time.
